externalActions.rollback: Keep the durable store and audit history during code rollback. Verify old code remains compatible with current hashes/schema. checks.instruction: Inspect the application environment and proxy topology without reading secret values. Record exact application, HTTPS origin, durable storage and session/cookie policy. Obtain approval before configuration/restart. The private bootstrap runs only after approved schema verification, accepts identity/password through hidden interactive prompts, and requires the exact create-first-administrator confirmation. No password in arguments, environment variables, chat, Git or CI. Verify normal-user and administrator journeys privately. Revocation and recovery require explicit target/account scope; retain only synthetic or redacted evidence.
checks.expected: Approved target and representative hosted journey verified; owner separately accepts.
